claims.text: The consumed sections define VALL-E 2: grouped-code language modelling (group size 1/2/4/8 with autoregressive group embedding/prediction plus non-autoregressive remaining codes) with repetition-aware sampling (nucleus sampling then random fallback on repetition-ratio threshold); parity defined as word-error-rate-reduction / CMOS / SMOS deltas above ground truth on LibriSpeech/VCTK.
